description: Visual-feedback MCP tools (document_render_preview / document_render_pdf): render a DocumentEditor document (by id or inline JSON) to per-page base64 PNG previews (pages selection, dpi, maxPages cap) or a WYSIWYG PDF (DocumentPdfExportOptions passthrough incl. page setup, review display mode and forensic watermark) via the headless pipeline (ITempoDocumentService). Fail-closed: font-catalog gaps produce an agent-friendly diagnostic instead of synthetic metrics.
